# dsh-weknora-ops
**The write path and governance for WeKnora in your DeepSeek Harness agent — document ingest, gated
deletes, tag trees — under a three-layer safety model.**
A DeepSeek Harness plugin (skill + `weknora-ops` CLI) for WeKnora, the open-source knowledge-base pl
eek Harness plugin (skill + `weknora-ops` CLI) for WeKnora, the open-source knowledge-base platform.
> **Relation to the official plugin**: WeKnora ships its own read-only DSH plugin, `@wxg-prc-cpg/dsh
-weknora` — four query tools (list/search/read/ask), native cordis tools, contract-tested. **For que
rying, use theirs.** This project covers what the official one deliberately does not: the *write* pa
th — ingest, deletion under a double gate, tag trees — plus read verbs for environments where a CLI
form factor is preferred. Both can be installed side by side.
> Independent community project. Not affiliated with DeepSeek or Tencent. Bundle format follows the
MIT-licensed dsh-superagent-prototype; WeKnora API surface per its public docs. 中文文档
## Why
Coding agents confidently hallucinate exactly the things your team wrote down somewhere: product rul
es, deploy procedures, compliance constraints, research conclusions. WeKnora holds that ground truth
— this plugin puts it one command away and enforces a simple discipline: **cite, don't recall**.
## Capabilities
| | Command | What it does |

| **Query** | `weknora-ops ask <kb> "<q>"` | Knowledge-grounded answer **with references** |
| | `we

knora-ops search <kb> "<q>" --top-k 5` | Hybrid retrieval (vector + keyword) with cited chunks |
| |

`weknora-ops kb list` / `kb show` | Knowledge bases |
| | `weknora-ops doc list <kb>` | Documents +

parse status |
| | `weknora-ops tagtree <kb>` | Hierarchical tag tree (filter hint: subtree tag ids

) |
| **Ingest** | `weknora-ops doc upload / url / manual` | Add documents, web pages, manual knowle

dge |
| **Destructive** | `weknora-ops doc delete … --yes` | Delete a document (double-gated) |
## Safety model — three layers
1. **Skill etiquette** (`skills/dsh-weknora-ops/SKILL.md`): reads are agent-free; ingests only when
a person asked; deletes need explicit in-conversation confirmation. Nothing in the skill grants perm

ission — the surrounding conversation does.
2. **CLI gate**: `doc delete` refuses without `--yes`.
3
. **Enforcement (the real wall)**: a workspace-scoped API key with capabilities `retrieve` / `chat`
/ `ingest`. A key without `manage_kbs` simply cannot do damage, whatever the agent tries — 403 is th
e answer, not an obstacle to work around.
This mirrors the admission-control philosophy of dsh-super-agent: trust is structural, not persuaded
his mirrors the admission-control philosophy of dsh-super-agent: trust is structural, not persuaded.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Into a DSH profile: apply this repo's `cordis.patch.yml` (see `examples/profile.cordis.patch.yml`),
or drop `skills/dsh-weknora-ops/` into your profile's skills directory.
## Status
v0.1.1 — vertical slice: 7 read verbs, 3 ingest verbs, delete gate, unit tests. **Live-tested end to
end**: DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 (headless, DeepSeek provider) driving `weknora-ops` against a real WeKnora v3
.1.3 server — skill discovery, `status`, `kb list` (542 KBs), `search` with cited hits; the run also
caught and fixed two real integration bugs (env scrubbing → config file; `query_text`/`match_count`
on v0.8.0-line servers). `ask` follows the v5-line session flow — on older servers the skill falls
back to `search` + synthesis. Streaming answers, agent-chat operations and an MCP-endpoint mode are
` + synthesis. Streaming answers, agent-chat operations and an MCP-endpoint mode are on the roadmap.
